request: release notes drafts: version number, date, and lists of what is new, fixed and changed. mark published.

checklist.item: can add a release with version, date and text for new, fixed, changed

program:
app "Release notes" book plum
table draft title text, number text, due date, fixed bool, changed bool
count(draft where changed = no) "open" head
each draft where changed = no sort due as r
  row card gap 2 tap edit r swipe remove r
    toggle r.changed
    stack grow
      r.title bold
      r.due small color if(r.due < today, bad, muted)
form draft
"Done" faint
list draft where changed = yes
describe:
Release notes, in the plum colours.

- draft: title: text; number: text; due: date; fixed: yes or no; changed: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:

- for each draft where changed is no sorted by due:
  - a group; a tap opens the draft for editing; a swipe removes the draft, with undo:
    - a tick box for the changed of the draft.
    - text: the title of the draft.
    - text: the due of the draft.
- a form to add a draft.
- text: "Done".
- a list of draft where changed is yes; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

request: monthly budget as a fuel gauge, add spends and the needle goes down. budget 50000

program:
app "Fuel gauge" car mint
table fuel spendamount money
setting budget money = 50000 "Monthly budget"
let p = clamp(sum(fuel.spendamount month) / budget, 0, 1)
draw 100, 6
  line 0, 6, 100, 6 stroke soft thick 10
  poly stroke accent thick 10
    each 1..min(budget, 100) as i
      i tiny color muted
      if(i <= budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(i - budget) big
quick fuel, spendamount, [2000, 5000, 10000]
form fuel
describe:
Fuel gauge, in the mint colours.

- fuel: spendamount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 50000.

- p is the total spendamount of fuel this month divided by budget kept between 0 and 1.
Shows:
- a drawing made of lines, a line through points.
- one-tap buttons that add a fuel with spendamount set to each of 2000, 5000, 10000.
- a form to add a fuel.

request: School van fees tracker for the 14 kids I drive. Each child has monthly fee (some 3000, some 3500), I mark which months are paid. At the end I want to see who hasn't paid this month and the total collected.

app "Van fees" bus slate
table kid name text
table fee kid ref kid, amount money
"Collected this month" sum(fee.amount month) big
each kid as k
  let due = sum(k.fee.amount month)

    row
      k.name head grow
      "due" due bold color if(due > 0, bad, good)

request: Water tank filler: tank is 4ft x 3ft x 3ft, pump gives 20 litres per minute. How long to fill and how many litres does it hold?

checklist.item: inputs for tank dimensions and pump rate
converts cubic feet to litres correctly

program:
app "Fuel" car slate
table fill litres num 1..200
"Capacity" max(fill, 20) "litres" big
"Each add one" sum(fill.litres) "litres" faint
each fill sort at as f
  row card gap 2
    f.at bold grow
    f.litres "litres" bold
form fill, "Add fill"
describe:
Fuel, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- fill: litres: number, 1 to 200. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: "Capacity", the highest of 20 over the fill, "litres".
- text: "Each add one", the total litres of fill, "litres".
- for each fill sorted by at:
  - text: the at of the fill.
  - text: the litres of the fill, "litres".
- a form to add a fill.

request: cricket net sessions - date, how long (min), bowling or batting, what I worked on. chart per week would be nice

checklist.item: can log a session with date, minutes and bowling/batting choice
has a field for what was worked on
shows a chart of minutes per week or per day

program:
app "Net sessions" ball ocean
table session day date, team text, length num 1..240 = 240, bowling bool
let on_side = count(session week where day >= today)
"Net sessions this week" on_side big
each session week sort day as s
  row card gap 2
    stack grow
      s.day bold
      s.team "min" faint
    s.length "min" bold
    toggle s.bowling
form session, "Add session"
describe:
Net sessions, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- session: day: date; team: text; length: number, 1 to 240, starts at 240; bowling: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- on side is how many session entries this week where day is at least today.
Shows:
- text: "Net sessions this week", on side.
- for each session this week sorted by day:
  - text: the day of the session.
  - text: the team of the session, "min".
  - text: the length of the session, "min".
  - a tick box for the bowling of the session.
- a form to add a session.
